name: Self-order option row
describe: Variant or add-on option row from the product detail: flex justify-between rounded-lg border px-4 py-3; selected = border-primary bg-primary/10; rate in muted text, an em dash when the rate is null.

Use in the product detail screen under a "Variants" / "Add-ons" heading. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
